# BaMMI: Bayesian Microbiome-Metabolite Integration

BaMMI is an R package for Bayesian microbiome-metabolite data 
integration. It provides two models:

1. **BSRMM** - Bayesian sparse regression for microbiome-metabolite 
   data integration for univariate metabolite outcomes.
2. **MALMO** - Microbiome association with left-censored and missing 
   metabolic outputs for multivariate metabolite outcomes.

For a full tutorial with detailed examples and output, please see the
package vignette:
```{r, eval = FALSE}
browseVignettes("BaMMI")
```

## Installation

You can install the development version of BaMMI from GitHub with:

```{r, eval = FALSE}
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("Kai-Jiang-1/BaMMI", build_vignettes = TRUE)
```

## Example: BSRMM

```{r bsrmm_data, eval = FALSE}
library(BaMMI)

set.seed(123)
mydata <- gen_missing_value(
  n = 200, p = 200, snr = 1,
  proportion = 0.30, type = "mnar0.33"
)

X <- scale(mydata$X)
Y <- as.matrix(mydata$Y_miss)
n <- nrow(X)
p <- ncol(X)
N <- rbind(diag(p), matrix(100, nrow = 1, ncol = p))

bsrmm <- bsrmmgibbs(
  nburnin = 5000, niter = 10000,
  p = p, nop = floor(n / 2),
  Y = Y, X = X, N = N,
  a = rep(-12, p), Q = mydata$Q, n = n
)
```

## Example: MALMO

```{r malmo_data, eval = FALSE}
set.seed(123)
mydata_mv <- gen_missing_value_mv(
  n = 50, p = 100, q = 3, snr = 1,
  proportion = 0.20, type = "mnar0.33"
)

result <- malmo_gibbs(
  Y = mydata_mv$Y_miss, X = mydata_mv$X,
  nburn = 10000, niter = 20000
)
```

## Citation

If you use BaMMI in your research, please cite the following papers:

**BSRMM**:

* Jiang, K., Saha, S., and Peterson, C. B. (2026). Bayesian sparse regression for microbiome–metabolite data integration. *Statistics in Medicine*, 45(13–14), e70607. [https://doi.org/10.1002/sim.70607](https://doi.org/10.1002/sim.70607)

**MALMO**:

* Jiang, K. and Peterson, C. B. Microbiome association with left‑censored and missing metabolic outputs. *Biostatistics* (under revision).
